description: The person's settings: weight unit, which nutrients beyond the macros show on their Food and Today screens, how much of a day's workout calories is added to their calorie target, their weight goal, and what the sled or bar of a plate-loaded or Smith machine weighs empty (baseWeights; a set's weight is the total, so plates loaded = weight - base). Also lists what only the person can change on the phone. Read-only.
name: trainrec_settings
title: Settings
